## Design

### 2026-10-19 – Started buiding the schematics for my project, then realised in the middle that my resistors for 5.1k wont work because my resistors that i plan to buy with starbie don't contain 5.1k's so im parallel

**1.22h**

Started buiding the schematics for my project, then realised in the middle that my resistors for 5.1k wont work because my resistors that i plan to buy with starbie don't contain 5.1k's so im paralleling 2 10ks. I also made an analog multiplexer to change the sounds of the notes, as well as make a coordinate based key system.

**1.37h**

today i finished up the wiring (which is now extremely constrained and I don't think i can fit any more if it rerquired any) but at least its done. had some random spoke warnings but realised that they are harmless, and resolved all DRC issues. also ran the ground pour so most of GND parts are connected, but i did have to wire a few in isolated islands. ### 2026-10-21 – i did a bunch of cad this session, mainly to make some keys for my synth, and it's been going quite swimmingly :). i needed to do some changes to make sure the holders were centered and to ensure that

**1.67h**

i did a bunch of cad this session, mainly to make some keys for my synth, and it's been going quite swimmingly :). i needed to do some changes to make sure the holders were centered and to ensure that the keys would leave enough tolerance between each other and the cherry mx stem, and also spent a long time importing the cherry mx stem because they don't come exported from kicad. i managed to finish all the white keys. (still need the black keys). my project is really beginning to take shape.

### 2026-10-22 – finished making the dark keys during this session, now the synth finally looks like a piano!! :)))) also made an enclosure, debated different sitkcing methods for the top panel. Decided in the end to

**2.22h**

finished making the dark keys during this session, now the synth finally looks like a piano!! :)))) also made an enclosure, debated different sitkcing methods for the top panel. Decided in the end to just use zip ties instead of bolts/screws or glue, since it's just easier. Then i modelled a top panel, and reallised that i would need to cut out too many holes so i gave up on it, as well as it would block the silkscreen art.
